_readme: S742, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). Butte 01312 (Real Estate A.S.): its major adds to the printed 39-40, general education is the Local pattern's 21, and the two add to 60-61 under the 62-69 its 'Map (Butte GE)' prints; its notes name the map's 2-unit Graduation Requirement Choice and an Area 4 choice 'Only necessary if not already met'. degree_electives_not_printed says the page prints no figure for electives and does not say they fill the rest, so this read makes the capture's own calls for the entry (cq_view, catalog 14): a session can read every line of the map with its units, whether any line is an elective, and the map's total, word for word. No model call, nothing written.

questions.map_lines: Every line of the 'Map (Butte GE)' with its units, any elective line and its note, and the map's 'Units:' total.
